title: Hevo Data Pipeline Freshness SLA
app: Hevo Data pipeline events via the Hevo API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=hevo:pipeline status="SUCCESS"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by pipeline_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>12
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Hevo Data pipeline and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A pipeline can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Hevo Data.
implementation: Ingest Hevo Data success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical pipeline exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of pipeline by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Hevo Data has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
